svg.aria-label: The Seminar + Portfolio task on one page. When your group presents: Opening Remarks (5–7 minutes), then upload 1, a summary and reflection of 150–200 words by Monday. Seminar one week later, then upload 2 by Monday. Video of up to 8 minutes, upload 3 within one week of your Seminar; this is the marked part. When another group presents: after their Opening Remarks, listen and complete the Feedback Tool, post 1–2 questions on the discussion board, and upload 150–200 words of feedback the same day. After their Seminar, listen and complete the Feedback Tool, discuss their two questions, and upload 150–200 words of feedback the same day. Three other groups times two is six uploads. In total: 2 presentations, 8 written uploads and 1 marked video.
